Claim boundary — enforced in the workbook and product

The source estate contains 82 E1 public facts: 31 APPROVED and 51 PENDING_REVIEW. Deterministic QA marks all 51 pending records DEVELOPER_VERIFIED, but that state is not finance-SME approval. Exactly 15 client-product cells may use approved anchors; 85 remain E0 prior-led. The active E1 pooling weight is 0.35 under v2-wallet-measurement-policy-1.1.0; the V1 weight 0.84 is retired. Typed/derived claims are not additional audited observations. No competitor share or causal uplift is labelled measured.

Trade Finance is first-ranked in 100% and majority-dominant in 87.8% of the current 10,000 governed benchmark draws. Under the separate E1-weight sweep it stays first but its top-10 share falls from 70% to 30%. Dominance is an output to re-test, never a release condition.
